path_index: Zero-based drawable path document order excluding defs. Definition paths marked unsupported definition-path.

coordinate_contract.phone: Back-view u=0.5-x/width; v=0.5-y/height. Source stylization uses body width for camera x AND y. Assignment compares source (x-x0,y-y0)/source_width with profile (width/2-x,height/2-y)/width.
coordinate_contract.landscape_tablet: Use existing 90deg 0deg 90deg orientation, then world part bounds. Back-view u=0.5+y/height; v=0.5-x/width; source camera y is scaled by source width, so comparison uses (u,v*width/height).
coordinate_contract.portrait_tablet: Back-view u=0.5-x/width; v=0.5-y/height; same width-scaled source comparison as phones.
coordinate_contract.indices: Minimum squared-distance bijection of measured source optical feature centers to actual profile camera.windows plus rear sensors; never use source lens ordinal as profile window index.

notes: No source geometry, paints or ordering corrected. Existing source stylization and quality retained.
Flash backing and diffuser both map to Flash 0 via renderer flash-rim-0 compositing. Sensor outer/inner fills share sensor-N layers.
Reviewed clip paths exactly duplicate body d. No transforms, strokes or articulated models enabled.
Floating camera models omit bar. Source capsules with multiple profile windows remain unsupported.
Mapping geometry is pinned; source semantic labels below were checked against generator-produced d strings without writing generated output.

excluded_families.other-brands-robots-laptops: Outside Samsung slab/tablet metadata scope; no edits.
